## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Validation

Describe the automated and manual checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated modifications.
- [ ] Lint and relevant tests pass locally.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior where applicable.
- [ ] Salesforce sharing, CRUD, FLS, and permission implications were reviewed.
- [ ] Browser preview and generated PDF were checked when rendering changed.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` were updated when required.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, record IDs, or organization-specific URLs were added.
